query: What signals suggest an incident resolution will be inefficient?

per_column.name: resolution_hours
per_column.rationale: Inefficiency of a resolution is essentially defined by how long it takes; resolution_hours is the underlying quantity from which 'inefficient_resolution' is derived. It is only fully known after the incident closes (closed_at - opened_at), so it both leaks and restates the outcome rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: above_p75_resolution
per_column.rationale: A binary flag for resolution time above the 75th percentile is a direct thresholded version of resolution_hours and almost certainly the very operationalization of 'inefficient_resolution'. It is a deterministic function of the outcome, hence leakage/restatement, not a predictor.

per_column.name: reassigned
per_column.rationale: Whether an incident was reassigned is a process signal that plausibly correlates with slow/inefficient handling but is not a deterministic component of resolution time. It can carry predictive signal without restating the focus, though it may be partly concurrent with the outcome.

per_column.name: high_complexity_category
per_column.rationale: Derived from category, known at intake, and independent of the resolution duration itself. Complexity plausibly predicts inefficiency, making it a legitimate feature.

per_column.name: critical_or_high_priority
per_column.rationale: Priority is set at/near opening and is external to the focus variable. It plausibly carries predictive signal about resolution efficiency and is not a component of it.

per_column.name: assignee_slow_relative_to_median
per_column.rationale: This flags the assignee as slow relative to median, which is itself computed from resolution-time behavior. It is effectively another thresholded restatement of the outcome (and uses post-hoc timing), so it leaks the focus rather than predicting it.

judge.rationale: Three of six columns (reassigned, high_complexity_category, critical_or_high_priority) are legitimate ex-ante predictors that add modest signal beyond the original schema. However, half the set (resolution_hours, above_p75_resolution, assignee_slow_relative_to_median) directly restates or leaks the focus variable, since 'inefficient_resolution' is essentially defined by resolution duration. The valid predictors offer real but limited leverage, so overall predictive utility is moderate.
